line.en: the bears host the saints at noon at soldier field, sunday. tickets from the bears or resale; the stadium is on the lakefront, so dress for the wind.
line.de: die bears empfangen die saints sonntag um 12:00 im soldier field. tickets über die bears oder den zweitmarkt; das stadion liegt am see, also auf den wind einstellen.
line.tr: bears pazar günü öğlen saints'i soldier field'da ağırlıyor. biletler bears'ten ya da ikinci elden; stadyum göl kenarında, rüzgara hazırlıklı git.

sparks.why: Bears vs Saints, home, sun 22 nov 12:00 CT at Soldier Field, per the Chicago Bears 2026 schedule listing (https://www.chicagobears.com/schedule/2026/); flex scheduling can move it.
